name: How long does it typically take to frame a partition wall?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to frame a partition wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to frame a partition wall varies based on its size, complexity, and the specific site conditions. A simple, straight wall in an existing structure might take a few hours for an experienced team. Larger or more intricate walls involving door openings, multiple corners, or integration with existing systems could take a day or more. This estimate does not include drywall, finishing, or painting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing time depends on wall size and complexity; a simple wall might take a few hours, while larger ones could take a day or more.
